impact: v2 save silently fails with "no committed segments available to pin" (T-038: rolling-buffer seal failure). T-039: B4 — segments_committed > 0 (up to 8) but pin always fails. T-042 (B4 repro under T-040/T-041 instrumentation): **Branch B confirmed** — segments_evicted == segments_committed at save time; trigger=age. Root cause: segment PTS duration (~38.6s) exceeds window_duration_90k (30s = 2,700,000 at 90kHz), so every committed segment is immediately evictable upon commit. Eviction fires every ~38s under static-screen/dedup conditions. Ring is always empty at save time. is_closing=false (not a closing-state race). Evidence: .story/handovers/evidence/2026-05-24-iss-015-b4-repro/. Related: T-038, T-039, T-040, T-041, T-042.
resolution: T-043 applied overlap-safe eviction predicate to evict_eligible in helper/src/segment/buffer.rs. T-044 validation: 2/2 saves reached EXPORTING and completed successfully under 4K/XR24/static-dedup conditions. committed_len_after=1 on all evictions (ring no longer emptied). No pin_snapshot empty-ring warning. Branch A confirmed.
title: v2 save silently fails: SAVING→RECORDING with no snapshot ID despite valid rolling buffer segments
